continuity: Ma Sanbao and roughly one thousand of his followers survived the ambush in a remote Henan valley; he was unable to move when Zhuge Feng, Baek Yeon, and the Son of Heaven confronted him.
Zhuge Feng had prepared a trap at the Magic Formation’s destination; about two thousand of Ma Sanbao’s troops died in the ambush.
Ma Sanbao had planned to divide his forces between Henan and Shanxi, intending to seize both provinces.
plot: Ma Sanbao assembled roughly five thousand troops, including three thousand monsters, and changed his plan to target Henan and Shanxi in two groups. He sent about three thousand followers through the Grand Mage’s Magic Formation, but an ambush prepared by Zhuge Feng killed roughly two thousand before they could begin their advance. Unable to move, Ma Sanbao recognized Zhuge Feng and threatened him.
Baek Yeon appeared with the Son of Heaven. The Emperor confronted Ma Sanbao as a traitor; the chapter ends with Ma groaning, without establishing the outcome of the confrontation.
translation_decisions: Render 강시술사 as “corpse sorcerer” and 마법진 as “Magic Formation.”
